<translate>
<!--T:6-->
'''Tien Shinhan''' (''Tien Shinhan (Early)'' in game) is one of the Z Fighters who can be drawn as a contender in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell Games|Cell Games]], and one of your sparring partners at [[Special:MyLanguage/Kami's Lookout|Kami's Lookout]] in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan Saga|Saiyan Saga]]. He uses Goku's body model with his own texture.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the tournament == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
Tien is one of the Cell Saga Z Fighters that fill the contender seats of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell Games|Cell Games]] bracket, hosted by [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell|Cell]]. Each run draws its contenders at random, each character at most once, so he isn't in every bracket; the draw is only revealed once everybody accepts the rules. His fellow contenders can include [[Special:MyLanguage/Android 16|Android 16]].

<!--T:9-->
His stats come from the seat he is drawn into: by default a contender has between 66,500 and 210,000 health, 2,700 to 8,700 melee damage and 2,420 to 7,820 ki damage, fights on the Novice, Smart or Elite AI tier, and gets 8% stronger for every round already played.

<!--T:10-->
The Cell Games are '''lethal''': losing a bout kills you. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Tournaments|Tournaments]] for how bouts work.
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior and abilities == <!--T:11-->

<!--T:12-->
Tien flies and has one ki attack, the '''Ki Laser''', a quick yellow beam. Every so often he steps out of the way of an attack. How well he uses them depends on his AI tier (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas#Enemy AI tiers|enemy AI tiers]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:13-->

<!--T:14-->
In the [[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan Saga|Saiyan Saga]] quest '''Sparring at the Lookout''' (quest 7) you defeat Krillin, Yamcha and Tien at [[Special:MyLanguage/Kami's Lookout|Kami's Lookout]].

<!--T:15-->
The tournaments of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Classic Saga|Classic Saga]] use two other Tien entities, each with its own look: '''Young Tien Shinhan''' (quest 35) and '''Tien Shinhan''' (quest 49).
</translate>
